coding.note: Emu3 is a released, author-trained multimodal model family. Claims are deduplicated across abstract and introduction; the single-transformer design and next-token objective are coded separately. No matched architecture/objective ablations are reported; comparisons against other model families do not qualify. DPO comparisons are POST and therefore NA under this protocol. Scaling potential is an introductory efficiency claim, not demonstrated scaling evidence. Automated image comparator scores are explicitly sourced from prior reports, while human comparisons are conducted by the authors; rerun and scores_copied are MIXED across results. No independent third-party evaluation of Emu3 is reported; using public benchmarks alone does not qualify. Comparator list includes all 12 models in Table 4 plus three prominent comparators from other main results, capped at 15. Data sources/categories are disclosed but not reconstructible mixture proportions. Training seeds, total pre-training tokens, and training compute are not reported.
